title: Coordinate m-covectors dual to the codimension-one faces of a coordinate (m+1)-plane
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let ι : Fin (m+1) → Fin P be strictly increasing, and write e_l := EuclideanSpace.single l 1 ∈ ℝ^P. There are m-covectors ε_0, …, ε_m on ℝ^P (ε : Fin (m+1) → Covector (Euclid P) m) with the following two properties for every c : Fin (m+1) → ℝ. (a) covectorEuclideanNorm(Σ_j c_j ε_j) = √(Σ_j c_j²), using the Euclidean coefficient norm of Simon 6.1.15. (b) For every j ∈ Fin (m+1), (Σ_{j'} c_{j'} ε_{j'})(fun k => e_{ι(j.succAbove k)}) = (−1)^j c_j. In words: evaluated on the tuple (e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(m)}) with its j-th vector removed, the form gives (−1)^j c_j.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (ι : Fin (m + 1) → Fin P), StrictMono ι → ∃ ε : Fin (m + 1) → Covector (Euclid P) m, (∀ c : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ, covectorEuclideanNorm (∑ j, c j • ε j) = Real.sqrt (∑ j, c j ^ 2)) ∧ ∀ (c : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (j : Fin (m + 1)), (∑ j', c j' • ε j') (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (ι (j.succAbove k)) (1 : ℝ)) = (-1) ^ (j : ℕ) * c j
